title.en: Attorney General's title and summary of Proposition 39, with the Analyst's fiscal estimate, Official Voter Information Guide
Legislative Analyst's analysis of Proposition 39, Official Voter Information Guide

explanation.en: The Attorney General's summary and the Analyst say mail voters would write the last four digits of a government-issued identification number on the ballot envelope, matching the number in their registration. The guide does not describe other personal details being added or assess identity-theft risk.

description.en: Official Voter Information Guide, argument against Proposition 39

sourceTitle.en: Official Voter Information Guide, November 3, 2026 General Election: arguments and rebuttals on Proposition 39

text: Prop. 39 will make every vote by mail voter include their personal details on their return envelope—making voters easy targets for identity theft.
